# Big Clear Puzzle Books

> Large-print word search and sudoku puzzles for seniors, adults, memory care and activity directors. Word search grid letters are 21 pt bold, one puzzle per page, words never run backwards, and every puzzle is generated and checked by software so each answer key is correct. Free printable PDFs on this site; printable books on Etsy; paperbacks on Amazon by Callan Brooks in the "Big Clear Puzzle Books" series.

## Free printables
- [Free large-print word searches](https://bigclearpuzzlebooks.com/word-search/): Christmas, Winter, Bible, Hymns, 1950s & 60s, Garden, Cooking & Baking, Thanksgiving; each a one-page PDF with answer key
- [Free large-print sudoku](https://bigclearpuzzlebooks.com/sudoku/): Easy, Medium and Hard, one big puzzle per page with solution
- [Free monthly puzzle pack by email](https://bigclearpuzzlebooks.com/#signup)

## Guides
- [What font size is large print?](https://bigclearpuzzlebooks.com/large-print-font-size/): 16, 18 or 21 point explained, with APH and RNIB definitions
- [Dementia-friendly printables](https://bigclearpuzzlebooks.com/dementia-friendly-printables/): what makes a puzzle easier to see and start, and which free printables to try first

## For activity directors
- [Activity directors and memory care](https://bigclearpuzzlebooks.com/activity-directors/): large-print word search and sudoku packs with a facility print license

## Where to buy
- [Etsy shop (printable PDFs)](https://bigclearpuzzlebooks.etsy.com)
- [Amazon paperbacks by Callan Brooks](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Callan+Brooks+large+print+word+search)

## Facts
- Word search: 21 pt bold grid letters, 18 pt word list, 10 to 12 words per puzzle, US Letter, one puzzle per page, answer key included
- Word directions: right, down, and diagonal down-right only
- Sudoku: one puzzle per page, a single solution, solvable by logic without guessing
- Contact: hello@bigclearpuzzlebooks.com
